source_title: Shreyas Iyer’s India find their feet after turbulent T20I run, but Wellington brings a new test - The Times of India
source_excerpt: The celebrations after India won the second T20I against New Zealand in Christchurch showed just how much the Men in Blue needed that result. Since winning the T20 World Cup, it has been a roller-coaster ride for the T20I team under new captain Shreyas Iyer, with India struggling to close out matches. It started on the Ireland tour, where India lost both matches while chasing, first by 34 runs and then by just one run.The poor form continued in the England series, where the hosts humbled India 4-0. This time, the team failed in both departments when it mattered.Ravi Bishnoi conceded 29 runs in the 17th over of the second match as the Three Lions cruised to victory with an over to spare.Then came a 76-run collapse as India slumped to their second-lowest T20I total in a 125-run defeat, their heaviest loss in the format.
